summary: SafeVault Phase 1 Task 3 (Document Library polish) frontend-only verification. TypeScript compile clean (exit 0). Static inspection of all 6 target files matches spec EXCEPT one deviation: pickAnyFile in file.tsx does NOT set fileHash on the draft (only pickImage and useSample do). E2E sort test on http://localhost:8081 at 420x900 fully PASSED: login-demo -> onboarding -> tab-docs; docs-sort-row present, all 4 chips (sort-name/added/modified/expiry) present and functional. Verified orderings: sort-name -> 'Car Insurance' first, sort-added -> 'Passport' first, sort-expiry -> 'Driving License' (expired) first and 'School Records – Aarav' (no expiry) last, sort-modified works. Regression testIDs (tab-home/timeline/docs/profile/add-fab, docs-search, docs-search-input, docs-filter-btn, docs-group-toggle, group-list, group-month) all present. No error-level frontend log entries beyond pre-existing shadow*/expo-notifications/RNGoogleSignIn warnings.

ui_bugs.issue: pickAnyFile does not set fileHash on the draft. Spec (Task 3 static-inspect item c) requires all three pickers (pickAnyFile, pickImage, useSample) to set fileHash via sha256OfBase64(b64). Currently only pickImage (line 80) and useSample (line 96) do. Consequence: hash-based duplicate detection will never fire for documents picked via the 'Document' choice (the primary path). Falls back to name+size check only.

issues: The 'Sort' label text overlaps the first chip in the horizontal ScrollView (visible as truncated 'ate added' on the 'Date added' chip when a non-first chip is active). Consider giving the ScrollView a small paddingLeft, or moving the label above the row, or reducing sortLabel's marginRight override.

action_items: Add fileHash: sha256OfBase64(b64) inside the setDraft() call in pickAnyFile (app/upload/file.tsx around line 44-50) so that hash-based duplicate detection works for the primary Document picker path, not just Image/Sample.
Fix docs-sort-row visual overlap between the 'Sort' label and the first chip when the ScrollView content is longer than the viewport.
critical_code_review_comments: app/upload/file.tsx pickAnyFile is missing fileHash assignment — leaves the primary picker path without SHA-256 duplicate detection.
review.tsx duplicate useMemo is correctly non-blocking (submit button disabled only by missing file/category, not by `duplicate`). Good.
docs.tsx sort logic: expiry sort pushes docs without expiry to the end as specified; name sort uses localeCompare with sensitivity:'base' (case-insensitive) as specified.
VaultContext.addDoc forwards fileHash via (input as any).fileHash — works but a typed field in the Omit signature would be cleaner.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing seeded 6 docs from VaultContext.buildSeed().
